additional_info.body:
Hello Shrey
The photo Sparki sended in this ticket is from a totally different problem with a charger where the Cfast card was not working anymore. An additional problem here is that the charger is stuck at the first “hallo/hello” screen and the charger won’t load the customers configuration. I think there is something wrong with the cfast card or PLC here. The photo that Sparki sended in the ticket was from a charger where the cfast flash was not working because of a similar, hello/hallo problem.
So the charger has two problems, broken plug and it is stuck at the first “hallo/hello” screen.
Hope this clarifies the picture.
Br.

additional_info.subject: ID0414562-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / PD 170001199]broken charger plug CRM:00798002086
additional_info.body:
Hi Team,
We have got 3 cases for this charger. We have merged all in one.
We could see Customer reported issue as broken charger plug.
We are seeking for the photographs from Customer, Which we didn't got as of now.
We have investigated the charger health.
Additionally, We could see following error flags.
DC2_CoolingUnit_EP1_Fan/Pump
BUS: 0 GSH: 0 GSS: 0 SDC: 0 SLK: 0 ErrorCode: 3
DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101
VIV:0 RNE:1 CBL:1 KON:1 CBL:1 HOU:1 CRet:1
Outlet_DC2_codes
DC2 Errorcode:4
outlet2
Outlet 2: outoforder, LEMState: Working
Meter_BC6_AC_Income
Modbus Error
PowerConverter[14]
Converter not found, CanCommLoss
PowerConverters
Missing Converters in DC3
BUS: 0  -
CAN bus lost/CAN wiring error/24V to cable lost
GSH: 0  -
Good signal lost / wiring error / LOGO comm lost / 24V to cable lost
ErrorCode: 3 -
Cable CAN communication Lost while charging is OFF
We need to check for the 24v and 0v.
Pls validate if FC16 is Healthy; And have 24v in the output.
For Cable Temp Error,
1.Pls measure CP pin to ground. If Voltage is different from constant 12V DC, the cable must be replaced. Report the findings on the ticket.
2. If Cable replaced ship the cable back to QM
For Modbus Error, as in Meter_BC6_AC_Income,
We need to investigate following connection.
Also,
We could see one converter is having the “Converter not found, CanCommLoss”
So, We need to check the suspected faulted converter by swapping with adjacent one and validate if the converter is Faulty or the connects is faulty.
We have to check the power converter whose serial number is absent in the following list.
Hope this will resolve the issue.
Do let us know if you needed assistance in site intervention.
